name: mon
description: Mon — exam-aligned spaced repetition for Mandarin, Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese. One shared domain core behind a backend; web and phone apps are interfaces.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @mon/core && npm run test --workspace @mon/api && npm run test --workspace @mon/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @mon/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @mon/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @mon/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @mon/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @mon/mobile
scripts.web:build: npm run icons && npm run build --workspace @mon/web
scripts.web:pages: npm run icons && npm run build:pages --workspace @mon/web
scripts.prebuild: npm run icons && npm run prebuild --workspace @mon/mobile
